description: Switch the file handler's level, format and path (three lines); console and audit use the same level/format lines. DISTILL-CANARY-0bebe7ce

files.logging.yaml:
handlers:
  console:
    level: INFO
    format: short
    stream: stdout
  file:
    level: INFO
    format: short
    path: /var/log/app/app.log
  audit:
    level: INFO
    format: short
    path: /var/log/app/audit.log

turns.prompt: For the file handler in logging.yaml set level DEBUG, format json and path /var/log/app/debug.log. Console and audit must keep their settings. Reply DONE when it's written.

logging.yaml.equals:
handlers:
  console:
    level: INFO
    format: short
    stream: stdout
  file:
    level: DEBUG
    format: json
    path: /var/log/app/debug.log
  audit:
    level: INFO
    format: short
    path: /var/log/app/audit.log
